description: This is a test class for the Education entity within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It contains setup and test methods to verify the proper creation and retrieval of Education entities.

classes.name: EducationTest
classes.description: Test class for the Education entity, verifying creation and retrieval of Education objects in the system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares the test environment by truncating the Education table to ensure a clean state before each test.

methods.name: testEducationEntity
methods.description: Tests creating a new Education entity, setting its name, saving it, and verifying retrieval and correctness of its properties.
